coverage.statement: Tracks Carl's consequential, persistent equipment, tattoos, vehicle, and high-value achievement chains. Its stable item and entitlement IDs are preserved by the compiler for later-floor replay. It intentionally omits routine loot, most consumables, and unresolved quantities.

sources.title: Bookworm Wiki: Dungeon Crawler Carl, Book 1 timeline
A Book Lover's Digest: Dungeon Crawler Carl, Book 1

items.name: Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling
items.description: A regenerating enchanted undershirt that resists several disruptive combat effects.

items.name: Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness
items.description: A cloak that adds 4 Constitution and provides poison, ice, and anti-piercing protection.

items.name: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk
items.description: A toe ring that adds 3 Strength and improves Powerful Strike.

items.name: Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces
items.description: Spiked kneepads that reflect 10% of damage and cancel momentum-based attacks.

items.name: Goblin Copper Chopper
items.description: A goblin-built chopper used for traversal and battlefield construction.

items.name: Enchanted War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull
items.description: A wrist brace that transforms into a spiked war gauntlet when Carl makes a fist, adding 1 Dexterity and 3 Strength in fist mode.

items.name: Silver Adventurer Box
items.description: Awarded for the Early Adopter achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

items.name: Bronze Adventurer Box
items.description: Awarded for the Empty Pockets achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

items.name: Gold Apparel Box
items.description: Awarded for the Why Aren't You Wearing Pants? achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

items.name: Bronze Weapon Box
items.description: Awarded for the Unarmed Combat achievement. Its later contents are not modeled here.

achievements.title: Empty Pockets
achievements.description: Entered the dungeon without supplies.

achievements.title: Why Aren't You Wearing Pants?
achievements.description: Entered the dungeon without pants.

achievements.title: Unarmed Combat
achievements.description: Entered the World Dungeon without a weapon.

achievements.title: Oooh, Magic!
achievements.description: Wore magical gear for the first time.

achievements.title: Boom!
achievements.description: Caused a wall-shaking explosion in the dungeon.

achievements.title: Podophilia!

reward.description: Gold Shoe Box containing the Enchanted Pedicure Kit of the Sylph

achievements.description: Killed an opponent by crushing it with bare feet.

achievements.title: Battlefield Construction!
achievements.description: Built and deployed a structure in battle.

achievements.title: Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady
achievements.description: The first crawler to enter the World Dungeon with a cat.

achievements.title: Early Adopter
achievements.description: One of the first 5,000 crawlers to enter a new World Dungeon.

achievements.title: Loner
achievements.description: Entered without any human companions.

achievements.title: Fall into an Obvious Trap
achievements.description: No achievement notification text is preserved by the source.

reward.description: A warning that Carl is about to meet his maker.

achievements.title: You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign
achievements.description: Read an official dungeon sign.

reward.description: Official signs are highlighted and nearby guilds appear on the minimap.

achievements.title: You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob
achievements.description: Damaged a mob for the first time.

reward.description: The mob will probably hit back.

achievements.title: You've Killed a Mob!
achievements.description: Killed a mob for the first time.

achievements.title: You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!
achievements.description: Killed an armed mob with bare hands.

achievements.title: You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level Than Yourself!
achievements.description: Killed a mob above Carl’s level.

achievements.title: You've Entered a Guildhall!
achievements.description: Entered a guildhall.

achievements.title: Level-Up, Baby!
achievements.description: Gained enough experience to reach a new level.

reward.description: No extra reward beyond the level.

achievements.title: Loot!
achievements.description: Wore an item found in the dungeon.

achievements.title: Boss Babe
achievements.description: Damaged a dungeon boss.

achievements.title: You Monster!
achievements.description: Killed goblin children during the goblin chieftain-room explosion.

achievements.title: War Criminal
achievements.description: Killed more than twenty noncombatants with one attack.

achievements.title: Two Chicks at the Same Time
achievements.description: Killed two mobs at once by using their bodies against one another.

achievements.title: Borough Boss!
achievements.description: Entered a borough-boss chamber.

achievements.title: Bully and a Thief!
achievements.description: Inadvertently took Agatha’s shopping cart into inventory during the Ball of Swine fight.

achievements.title: This Little Piggy Went to Market!
achievements.description: Killed more than five opponents in boss fights with bare feet.

achievements.title: You Found Stairs!
achievements.description: Found a stairwell down to the next floor.

reward.description: No material reward; surviving to read the notification is the reward.

achievements.title: Crazy Cat Lady
achievements.description: Entered the World Dungeon accompanied by a cat.

achievements.title: Bitchmeat
achievements.description: Was attacked by a fellow crawler in a safe room and required the system’s help.

events.summary: The First Floor opens and its five-day collapse countdown is displayed.
Carl and Donut enter the First Floor as the 4,119th and 4,122nd crawlers.
After Donut becomes a crawler, she forms the two-member Royal Court of Princess Donut with Carl.

party.name: The Royal Court of Princess Donut

events.summary: Carl unlocks Crazy Cat Lady.
Donut unlocks Trailblazing Crazy Cat Lady.
Carl unlocks Early Adopter.
The Dungeon System awards Carl a Silver Adventurer Box for Early Adopter.
Carl unlocks Empty Pockets.
The Dungeon System awards Carl a Bronze Adventurer Box for Empty Pockets.

Carl opens the Bronze Weapon Box awarded for Unarmed Combat.
Carl unlocks Loner.
Carl and Donut begin the First Floor tutorial.
Cascadia closes the surface stairwells; just under 13 million entered and fewer than 10 million remain.
Carl and Donut complete the First Floor tutorial.
Carl unlocks Fall into an Obvious Trap.
Carl unlocks You've Discovered and Read an Official Dungeon Sign.
Carl unlocks You've Inflicted Damage on a Mob.
Carl unlocks You've Killed a Mob!.
Carl unlocks You've Killed an Armed Mob with Your Bare Fucking Hands!.
Carl unlocks You've Killed a Mob a Higher Level Than Yourself!.
Carl unlocks You've Entered a Guildhall!.
Carl unlocks Podophilia!.
Carl unlocks Boom!.
Carl unlocks Level-Up, Baby!.
Carl reaches Level 2.
Carl receives the Goblin Pass Tattoo.
Carl acquires the Enchanted Trollskin Shirt of Pummeling.
Carl receives the basic healing spell in the Magic menu tutorial.
Carl unlocks Loot!.
Carl unlocks Oooh, Magic!.
Carl unlocks Boss Babe.
Carl acquires the Enchanted Nightgaunt Cloak of Stoutness.
Carl acquires the Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk.
Carl equips the Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk.
Carl reaches Level 3.
Carl acquires a Silver Ring of +1 CON.
Carl reaches Level 5.
The system reports 4,322,395 crawlers remaining on the First Floor.
The system reports 4,148,111 crawlers remaining on the First Floor.
The Royal Court confronts the Hoarder.
Carl acquires the Enchanted Spiked Kneepads of the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces after the Hoarder battle.

Dungeon Crawler World episode one airs, showing spine-covered wolves, fire blobs, floating stingrays, floating eyeballs, and the first Borough Boss defeat by a 10-person crawler group; 4,006,002 crawlers remain.

A Cascadia patch populates the Floor 2 stairs, announces the descent head-start rule, reports 15 Borough Bosses and more than 1,500 Neighborhood Bosses killed, and changes Fire Fingers, hallway-bathroom explosions, toilet paper, mob inventory, and inventory momentum rules.
Carl reaches Level 7.
Carl reaches Level 8.
Carl acquires the Goblin Copper Chopper.
Carl unlocks You Monster!.
Carl unlocks War Criminal.
The system reports 3,594,517 crawlers remaining on the First Floor.
Carl receives the Desperado Pass Tattoo.
Carl acquires a Silver Ring of +2 CON.
Carl reaches Level 9.
Carl reaches Level 10.
Dungeon Crawler World episode two airs, including the Royal Court's encounter with Frank Q and Maggie My.

First Floor rules change: toilet suction and bathroom explosions are resolved; language and cross-language support are added; Feral Rabies is curable and no longer airborne; Blender Fiends move down; Street Preacher becomes a Borough Boss; mob strength levels are adjusted.
Donut receives Puddle Jumper from the post-Juicer loot boxes.
Carl acquires the Enchanted War Gauntlet of the Exalted Grull.
A crawler unlocks Bitchmeat.
Carl unlocks Two Chicks at the Same Time.
The Royal Court meets Meadow Lark.
Dungeon Crawler World episode three airs as the system reports 2,552,085 crawlers remaining.
A late First Floor patch changes spells and mob power levels and reiterates the warning not to use hallways as bathrooms.
Royal Court, Meadow Lark, and Agatha defeat the Ball of Swine using Carl's explosives and the dungeon architecture.
Crawlers can descend to Floor 2 without the usual six-hour loss.
The party unlocks Borough Boss!.
Carl unlocks Bully and a Thief!.
Carl unlocks Battlefield Construction!.
Carl unlocks This Little Piggy Went to Market!.
The party unlocks You Found Stairs!.
Carl reaches the stairs and completes the First Floor.
The First Floor collapses; 1,292,526 crawlers remain and more than 700,000 die in the collapse.
Dungeon Crawler World episode four airs, highlighting three-headed baboons, eggplants with teeth, crawler fights, and races for the stairs.
